clinical_note: Patient presents with persistent productive cough, high fever, and shortness of breath for 3 days. Chest X-ray confirms left lower lobe infiltrate. Diagnosed with acute bacterial pneumonia.

Patient presents with severe throbbing headache on the right side accompanied by nausea and photophobia. Denies history of hypertension. Assessment: Migraine without aura.
